description: §5.2 "Data never moves the document base (S473)": a `<base>` whose `href` (any case) is not a static string — a cell read, a call — is refused: three `<base>` elements, three reports. impl#1 emits it under the S479 carve-out 2 as widened S480 (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S480-census-recs item 5, gap g-impl1-renders-href-unguarded-s480); before it, impl#1 compiled every one clean.
rationale: §5.2: "A `<base>` (tag compared case-insensitively) whose `href` (any case) is not a static string — `href=@u`, `href=(…)`, `href=name`, a call, an `<each>` row's field, a value a declaration's field supplies (reported once, at the definition) — SHALL be a compile error (E-ATTR-BASE-HREF)."
